当前，世界百年变局加速演进，新一轮科技革命和产业变革加速突破，全球人工智能技术创: Currently, the century-old changes in the world are accelerating, a new round of scientific and technological revolution and industrial transformation are breaking through at an accelerated pace, global artificial intelligence technology innovation has entered an unprecedented period of activity, intelligent technologies featuring the Internet of Everything, human-machine collaboration, cross-domain integration, and co-creation and sharing are releasing enormous energy, which both contains tremendous opportunities and faces governance challenges.

要抓住难得的历史性机遇，鼓励开源开放、合作共享，全面促进人工智能科技创新、产业发: We must seize this rare historical opportunity, encourage open source and openness, collaborative sharing, comprehensively promote artificial intelligence scientific and technological innovation, industrial development, and scenario applications, and coordinately advance the transformation and upgrading of traditional industries, the cultivation and strengthening of emerging industries, and the forward-looking layout of future industries, enabling artificial intelligence to empower thousands of industries.

要用全人类共同价值塑造人工智能的价值观，善用人工智能技术增进不同文明的理解和包容: We should shape artificial intelligence's values with the shared values of all humanity, wisely use artificial intelligence technology to increase understanding and tolerance among different civilizations, promote exchange and mutual learning among different civilizations, and carefully cultivate a garden of civilizational diversity where each civilization is beautiful in its own right and where beauty is shared among all.
人工智能是全人类共同的智慧结晶和宝贵财富: Artificial intelligence is the common crystallization of wisdom and precious wealth of all humanity.

同时，中国始终坚持发展和安全并重，把握人工智能发展趋势和规律，不断完善相关法律法: At the same time, China has always upheld equal emphasis on development and security, grasped the trends and laws of artificial intelligence development, continuously improved relevant laws and regulations, policies and systems, application standards, and ethical guidelines, ensured artificial intelligence is safe, reliable, and controllable, and enabled this galloping steed of artificial intelligence to run both fast and steady.

人工智能发展不应该是某个国家的独奏，而应当是全球合作的交响: Artificial intelligence development should not be a solo performance by one country, but rather a symphony of global cooperation.
在各方共同努力下，世界人工智能合作组织在上海应运而生，一年前的构想已经转化为实际: With the joint efforts of all parties, the World Artificial Intelligence Organization came into being in Shanghai as the times required, and the vision conceived a year ago has been transformed into tangible results.
为进一步支持全球人工智能发展、推进全球人工智能能力建设，我宣布，未来5年，中国将: To further support global artificial intelligence development and advance global artificial intelligence capacity building, I announce that over the next five years, China will provide 5,000 artificial intelligence specialized training and research positions for developing countries.
”人工智能技术发展越是一日千里，向上向善、造福人类的方向越要正确锚定，监管治理的: "The faster artificial intelligence technology develops, the more we must correctly anchor its direction toward upward and benign development that benefits humanity, the more precisely we must grasp the measure of regulatory governance, and the more timely we must improve measures to prevent loss of control."
要始终用人类智慧和国际共识引领人工智能发展，使其真正成为增进全人类福祉、推动人类: We must always guide artificial intelligence development with human wisdom and international consensus, so that it truly becomes a powerful positive force for increasing the well-being of all humanity and promoting human civilization progress.
二〇二六世界人工智能大会暨人工智能全球治理高级别会议主席声明: 2026 World Artificial Intelligence Conference and High-Level Meeting on Global Artificial Intelligence Governance—Chairperson's Statement
2026年7月17日至20日，2026世界人工智能大会暨人工智能全球治理高级别会: From July 17-20, 2026, the 2026 World Artificial Intelligence Conference and High-Level Meeting on Global Artificial Intelligence Governance was held in Shanghai, China.
在新一轮智能浪潮席卷全球的重要历史节点，大会以“智能伙伴 共创未来”为主题，共: At this critical historical juncture as a new wave of intelligence sweeps across the globe, the conference, themed "Intelligent Partners, Co-creating the Future," jointly explored how to promote global artificial intelligence toward inclusive and beneficial development.
大会认为，人工智能全方位重构人类经济社会发展模式，将对人类文明进步产生深远影响: The conference believes that artificial intelligence is comprehensively reshaping the development model of human economics and society, and will have a profound impact on human civilization progress.
人工智能带来的机遇和挑战同步上升，一方面，人工智能深度融入产业、民生、科研等诸多: Opportunities and challenges arising from artificial intelligence rise simultaneously. On one hand, artificial intelligence is deeply integrated into many sectors including industry, people's livelihoods, and scientific research, injecting strong momentum into economic transformation, technological breakthroughs, and efficiency improvements.
另一方面，在人工智能持续迭代过程中，技术伦理、数据安全、监管体系等问题也随之凸显: On the other hand, in the process of continuous artificial intelligence iteration, issues such as technical ethics, data security, and regulatory systems have become increasingly prominent.
大会认为，人工智能是全球治理的最新课题，要秉持“同球共济”精神，通过人工智能国际: The conference believes that artificial intelligence is the latest subject in global governance, and we must uphold the spirit of "sharing the same globe and caring for each other," using international artificial intelligence coordination to establish a new paradigm for global governance.
应当统筹发展和安全、平衡创新和治理、兼顾本国利益和全球福祉，坚持以人为本、智能向: We should balance development and security, coordinate innovation and governance, and take into account both national interests and global well-being. We should adhere to the principles of people-centered development, intelligent development for good, equitable inclusivity, and coordinated co-governance, strengthen international cooperation on artificial intelligence, discuss and resolve major issues and pressing challenges facing humanity in the intelligent era, place international cooperation on artificial intelligence capacity building in a prominent position in global artificial intelligence governance, focus on resolving prominent issues such as uneven resource distribution and unfair power allocation, help countries in the Global South benefit equally in the process of artificial intelligence development, contribute to the implementation of the UN 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development, and ensure artificial intelligence benefits all humanity.
一、创新是人工智能发展的核心驱动力: 1. Innovation is the core driver of artificial intelligence development.
人在人工智能发展中发挥关键作用，要高度重视培养具备数字和人文素养、创新能力和全球: Humans play a key role in artificial intelligence development, and we must place high importance on cultivating talent in the artificial intelligence field with digital and humanities literacy, innovation capacity, and global vision.
二、推动人工智能赋能千行百业、走进千家万户: 2. Promote artificial intelligence to empower thousands of industries and enter thousands of households.
人工智能具有鲜明赋能属性，应当积极推广“人工智能+”模式，激发全球创新活力，探索: Artificial intelligence has distinct enabling attributes and should actively promote the 'Artificial Intelligence+' model, stimulate global innovation vitality, explore new scientific research paradigms, build a new form of intelligent economy, cultivate a new token economy model based on large models and driven by intelligent agents, coordinately advance the transformation and upgrading of traditional industries, the cultivation and strengthening of emerging industries, and the forward-looking layout of future industries, and promote the application of artificial intelligence in science, education, industry, agriculture, health, transportation, climate, environment, government services, and other sectors.
三、开源开放是人工智能普惠发展的重要路径: 3. Open source and openness are important pathways for inclusive development of artificial intelligence.
应当以负责任的方式鼓励共建开源生态，积极打造开放包容的国际开源社区，尊重企业自主: We should encourage the co-construction of open-source ecosystems in a responsible manner, actively create open and inclusive international open-source communities, respect enterprises' autonomous choices, and under the premise of emphasizing intellectual property protection, promote the sharing of artificial intelligence research results and technological experience, and enhance the accessibility of artificial intelligence technology and services.
四、数据在人工智能发展中发挥重要作用: 4. Data plays an important role in artificial intelligence development.
五、发展可持续的人工智能，推进人工智能与能源系统的深度融合: 5. Develop sustainable artificial intelligence and promote deep integration of artificial intelligence with energy systems.
通过在新能源富集地区布局规模化智算集群，引导算力负荷与电力资源的协调调度，关注人: By deploying large-scale AI computing clusters in areas rich in new energy, guiding coordinated scheduling of computing load and electricity resources, paying attention to the impact of artificial intelligence on energy consumption and ecological environment, promoting green and low-carbon artificial intelligence development, and facilitating mutual empowerment between artificial intelligence and energy.
六、关注人工智能技术对社会转型的影响，系统评估和应对人工智能对就业结构的冲击，发: Sixth, pay attention to the impact of artificial intelligence technology on social transformation, systematically assess and respond to the impact of artificial intelligence on employment structure, leverage the potential of artificial intelligence in creating jobs, actively develop artificial intelligence education and skills training, stimulate innovation and entrepreneurship throughout society, effectively protect the rights and dignity of workers, and build a more humane intelligent society
